name: Trucking
description: Commercial trucking operations hauling freight for hire or for the insured's own goods.

name: Commercial Fleet
description: Fleets of commercial vehicles owned or leased and operated for business purposes.

name: Commercial Passenger Vehicle
description: Vehicles used to carry passengers for business, such as shuttles, limousines and taxis.

name: Motor Carrier
description: Operations licensed as motor carriers transporting property or passengers across state lines or within a state.

name: Vehicle Delivery
description: Operations delivering vehicles or goods to customers, including driveaway and courier delivery.

name: Auto Transport
description: Car-hauler operations transporting automobiles on trailers or carriers.
